cards.quote: Adrien joined our team as a freelancer and the experience was excellent. I particularly appreciated how autonomous he was from day one, his meticulousness and how easy he is to communicate with. Nothing to fault on his technical level either. Adrien fitted easily into the team's processes.

Adrien is without a doubt the developer I've enjoyed working with most as a product designer. He listens, challenges, and supports the product thinking while bringing his engineering mindset, always with kindness and intelligence.
We hired Adrien to build a feature for our LMS (NextJS, Python etc.). He grasped the stakes and needs very quickly, then delivered the work at pace. No complaints: it was a superb experience.
